title: Materials Coordinator
description:
Tittle: Materials Coordinator
Location: Midland, GA (Onsite)
Type: Fulltime
Rate: $75-80K

Job Description & Skill Requirement:

This is an on-site position, meaning much of this role will require working out of our customers' facilities located in Columbus, Georgia.

Duties/Responsibilities
  • Spend significant time on the manufacturing floor, walking the line, checking material status, and identifying potential flow issues.
  • Monitor work-in-process (WIP) materials, identify jobs at risk due to material issues, and expedite inbound/outbound materials accordingly.
  • Work closely with production supervisors and planners to prioritize job material needs, align allocations, and escalate when issues arise.
  • Coordinate with procurement/supply chain for supplier delays, shortages, expediting special components, and maintaining visibility of material lead-times.
  • Update the ERP/MRP system (or equivalent) with material movement, job status, and inventory status, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records, support physical counts, and identify discrepancies between system and actual material stock.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts: suggest and implement improvements in material flow, kitting, Kanban systems, FIFO/FEFO, 5S adherence in material storage areas.
  • Participate in daily/weekly production meetings, provide status on material readiness and risk to meet delivery commitments.
  • Build strong relationships with cross-functional teams (engineering, quality, production, logistics) to drive operational effectiveness.
  • Adhere to aerospace manufacturing standards, quality requirements, safety rules, and regulatory obligations.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement projects, reducing cycle times, eliminating bottlenecks, and enhancing throughput.

Required Skills/Abilities:
  • Proactive, high-urgency mindset - you see material risks and act before they become schedule issues.
  • Strong sense of ownership of material flow and schedule delivery performance.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills - you'll coordinate across functions and work on the floor with production teams.
  • Detail-oriented yet capable of seeing the bigger picture: you track individual parts but also understand job/execution level risks.
  • Adaptable and resilient: manufacturing priorities shift, and you'll need to adjust material flow accordingly.

Education and Experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Technology or related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 3-5 years of experience in materials management, production control, manufacturing operations (preferably in aerospace or heavy manufacturing).
  • Strong familiarity with ERP/MRP systems and shop-floor material flow (e.g., kitting, WIP staging, job prioritization).
  • Demonstrated ability to work on the floor, interact with production teams, escalate and resolve material flow issues in real-time.
  • Good analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with a track record of driving follow-through on issues and providing reliable status updates.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven manufacturing environment.
  • Familiarity with Lean manufacturing, 5S, continuous improvement is a plus.
  • Ability and willingness to spend significant time walking the manufacturing floor (standing, walking, sometimes lifting moderate loads, interacting with operators/supervisors).
  • Aerospace manufacturing environment experience is desirable (but not necessarily mandatory if strong manufacturing materials experience is present).

Physical Requirements:
  • Prolonged periods standing and sitting at a desk working on a computer.
  • Prolonged periods of standing and the ability to traverse a shop environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds at times.

title: CC&B Billing Consultant
description:
About Client:
The client is a multinational technology company, known for its e-commerce, cloud computing, digital streaming, and artificial intelligence services. It started as an online bookstore and expanded into a global marketplace offering a vast range of products and services. It operates a leading cloud computing platform, and owns subsidiaries like Whole Foods, Twitch, and Audible. Client is also a leader in smart home technology with Alexa-powered devices. With a strong focus on innovation, logistics, and customer service, it is one of the world’s most valuable and influential companies.

Role: CC&B Billing Consultant
Location: Remote

IN SCOPE:
The scope involves following key aspects, as well as the deliverables.
Following is the detailed scope of the services –
  • Building or modifying SQL queries
  • UAT testing and signoff
  • Production deployment
  • Fulfillment of Bill Reprint, Pocket Assignments, Bill Inserts and Mass Transactions

Overview
Requirements, expectations, and process for a contractor to manage Mass Transaction (MT) jobs feeding the CC&B billing system, ensure monthly bill inserts/messages, and maintain service levels. Covered technical depth (especially SQL), data quality checks, limited UAT (User Acceptance Testing), work hours, interview steps, current support model, and rate guidance.

Scope: Mass Transaction jobs and CC&B billing
MT jobs are manually triggered processes that take client-provided file inputs with defined parameters and load processed results into the CC&B billing system.
Clients often provide lists that require cleansing; multiple “empty jobs” exist and are run based on need.
High data accuracy is critical; once records are loaded, errors can cause business repercussions.

Required skills and responsibilities
  • Operate and manage MT jobs end-to-end: validate inputs, run jobs, monitor outcomes, and handle errors.
  • Perform data checks and cleansing to remove duplicates and bad data prior to loading.
  • Be detail-oriented; communicate clearly with stakeholders; understand what success/failure looks like and appropriate follow-ups.
  • Programming familiarity sufficient to read job code when needed, interpret error codes, and support troubleshooting (not heavy development work).
  • SQL expectations and safeguards
  • SQL skill level: medium but capable of complex queries (not a “guru” or DBA). Must competently use joins (inner, outer, left, right) and subqueries.
  • All production queries require review before execution. Past incidents of poorly constructed queries slowed billing and impacted SLA (Service Level Agreement); strict caution is required.
  • UAT testing clarification
  • UAT (User Acceptance Testing) is minimal: small tests such as running one or two records to validate expected behavior before a full MT run.
  • May also apply to bill insert/message checks; overall “nothing really complicated.”
  • Collaboration on monthly bill inserts/messages
  • Recurring, standard monthly work with the bill print team to capture business needs and ensure correct implementation.
  • Clearly articulate details of bill messages and inserts so they are loaded and printed correctly.
  • Work hours and support model

Non-benefitted (other than those mandated under state or federal law).Please note that this position does not include paid time off benefits. ApTask offers subsidized insurance coverage to our employees.

description:
Job Title: Sr. HTML Specialist
Location: New York City, NY – Hybrid Role OR Remote
The Opportunity:
We’re looking for a senior front-end design technologist who specializes in one of the most demanding forms of digital craftsmanship: HTML email development. This full-time, U.S.-based contract role is for someone who is not only deeply familiar with the quirks and constraints of email clients but finds joy in outsmarting them—building layouts that look beautiful and perform flawlessly across desktop, mobile, and tablet in both light and dark modes.
You’ll join the global technology team within Apollo, reporting to the Head of UX & Creative and partnering closely with design, content, and technology leads. Your work will bring our internal campaigns and communications to life at scale, supporting sophisticated enterprise needs with the speed and reliability they demand.
It's very, very important that this person be more than just a front-end generalist (although those are good secondary skills)... they must have strong experience working at enterprise-scale specifically with HTML email templates, preferably in a B2C marketing team or similar, and be interested in continuing in that work. Folks with pedigrees at notable B2C tech firms/unicorns are of particular interest.

What We’re Looking For
We need an expert email developer who thrives on precision, consistency, and the challenge of building in a medium most developers avoid. You’re on target if you:
  • Have 5–7+ years of experience coding HTML/CSS emails at scale for large organizations or enterprises, with a portfolio to prove it
  • Are deeply fluent in the nuances of email development: nested tables, inline styles, VML for Outlook, responsive/adaptive layouts using email client-compatible media queries, and dark mode/light mode considerations
  • Stay up to date on the very latest email client and rendering engine compatibility (e.g., Microsoft Word rendering in Outlook, Gmail, WebKit for Apple Mail, etc.), and the effective tricks of the trade to achieve consistently elevated, bulletproof deliverables across complex templates
  • Know how to collaborate with designers and translate Figma designs into exacting, functional code
  • Can write clean, well-commented markup that others can extend or troubleshoot quickly under time crunch
  • Familiarity and an eye for detail with accessibility best practices in email (e.g.: semantic markup, alt text)
  • Take pride in testing rigor. Litmus and similar platforms are second nature to you.
  • Have experience working within Pardot, Storyports, or similar WYSIWYG campaign builders (bonus points if you’ve built modular, reusable components in these tools)
  • Are comfortable working fast when priorities shift without sacrificing quality or reliability

You Might Be a Fit If You...
  • Find the quirks of email clients more fun than frustrating—building elegant code that works everywhere is a puzzle you enjoy solving
  • Get satisfaction from seeing your work scaled across thousands of sends, with every detail intact
  • Appreciate design craft and understand that typography, spacing, and hierarchy matter as much in an inbox as they do on the web
  • Have the temperament of both a perfectionist and a pragmatist—you sweat the details but know when to ship

• Review and approve work by outside laser service technicians
• Assist in identifying and developing corrective actions and communicating to stake holders

• Bachelor’s degree in Physics, Optical Sciences or Engineering, Health Physics, Nuclear Engineering, Nuclear Physics or a related discipline (Direct experience as a Laser Safety Officer (LSO)or Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) in lieu of degree)

• Familiarity with multiple types of radiation sources including, x-ray generating machines, lasers and LEDs
